name: Valkyrie: The Fall
source: Facing stalemate in centuries-long war against their hated enemies, Alliance of Free Planets deploys one of their best units, all-female 6th Independent Battalion, in a quest to thwart a dangerous Neo-Terran research project. But even the most capable soldiers of the Alliance are not prepared for dangers that lurk in the forgotten corners of the galaxy.
